page.layout: One page of text: centred heading at top; introductory paragraph; a list of six synods with years in two columns; a paragraph with a dated line in italics; a closing line; catchword at lower right.

main_text.head: SYNODI NATIONALES
main_text.p: A Reformatis Ecclesijs Belgicis tum extra Belgium propter persecutionem Hispanicam, tum in Belgio celebratæ fuerunt,

Ab eo tempore nulla Synodus Nationalis in Bel-gio haberi potuit: Septima autem, ex decreto Illustr. & Præpotent. ORDINUM GENE-RALIUM BELGICÆ, celebrabitur (volente DEO, qui eidem clementer benedicat,)

page.notes: Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible at top right and was left out. The "HARMO-" catchword is at lower right. Printing irregularities (space before commas, "D E o" spacing in DEO) were left as printed or normalised where noted. Roman numerals in the list are printed with differing letterforms, read as I–VI.
